name: embspatial-bench-eval
description: EmbSpatial Bench Eval measures how well embedding models capture and represent spatial relationships between entities and locations. It evaluates embedding similarity and ranking on tasks that require spatial reasoning (e.g., relative positions, containment, distance). The benchmark is designed for retrieval/ranking-style evaluations using text-derived embeddings.
reputation: A niche benchmark focused on spatial properties of text embeddings with modest community use.
